name: NautilusTrader
description: Open-source Rust/Python trading engine with a native Lighter adapter for market data and execution.
longDescription:
NautilusTrader is an open-source, high-performance algorithmic trading platform written in Rust with a Python API, used for backtesting and live trading with the same strategy code.

It ships a native Lighter adapter covering market data and order execution on Lighter Core and the Robinhood Chain deployment. Docs: https://nautilustrader.io/docs/latest/integrations/lighter/
